title: 법관의 국제기구 파견 등에 관한 규칙 / queue:ARTICLE:3:0:00003:part:1/1
title_original: 법관의 국제기구 파견 등에 관한 규칙
full_text:
Article 3 (Selection of Seconded Judges, etc.)
(1) Judges and court officials to be seconded to international organizations, etc. (hereinafter referred to as "seconded judges, etc.") shall be selected from among judges and court officials possessing a certain level of proficiency in a foreign language, taking into consideration diligence and attitude in performing duties, contributions to the courts, expertise in work related to international organizations, etc., and other relevant factors.
(2) Where necessary for selecting seconded judges, etc., the Minister of the National Court Administration may require the presentation of test results issued by an accredited language testing institution and may conduct foreign-language proficiency assessments through interviews or other methods.
